title: Trezzi Farm Winery

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Discover Trezzi Farm Winery, a unique Spokane event venue and catering company located just 13 miles north of downtown Spokane, Washington in the historic farming community of Green Bluff. Relaxed and private, the venue enjoys stunning mountain, farmland and vineyard views. The farm’s estate wines and catering are handcrafted by the owner Davide Trezzi, from Milan, Italy, and the winery features the only full production estate vineyards in the Spokane area. This venue is the ideal choice for corporate, non-profit, and private event planners seeking a unique out-of-the-box experience for their guests. blurb: Welcome to Trezzi Farm Estate Winery located just north of Spokane, Washington in the historic farming community of Green Bluff. We’re a small family vineyard producing Italian wines with unique characteristics that reflect Green Bluff’s unique terroir - focusing on quality over quantity, and offering authentic wine experiences through sustainable practices.
